obligations.description: Typing 'Buy milk' in 'New Todo Input' and pressing Enter adds 'Buy milk' to the list and shows '1 item left!'.
Add 'Buy milk', check '❯ Toggle All Input', then add 'Walk the dog': tapping 'Clear completed' removes 'Buy milk' and keeps 'Walk the dog'.

With the single todo 'Buy milk', checking '❯ Toggle All Input' marks it completed: the screen shows '0 items left!' and the button 'Clear completed'. (The checkbox of one todo has no name, so tests use '❯ Toggle All Input'.)
With no todos the screen shows the heading 'todos' and the field 'New Todo Input', and no 'items left!' counter.

Add 'Buy milk', check '❯ Toggle All Input', then add 'Walk the dog': 'Active' shows only 'Walk the dog', 'Completed' only 'Buy milk', and 'All' both. On the web the filter is in the address (#/active, #/completed); on the phone it is state of this screen, so tests tap 'Active', 'Completed' and 'All' instead of opening those addresses.

intentionalDifferences.reason: The credits footer links to the external site http://todomvc.com; it leaves the app, so a test of this screen cannot check it.
The delete button appears only on mouse hover over a todo; touch screens have no hover.
Editing starts on double click on a todo; phones have no double click.
